attchmntText: ZUARI INDUSTRIES LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding amendment in the Code of Practices and Procedures for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information of the Company.
voiceSummary: Zuari Industries Limited has filed a revised Code of Practices and Procedures for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information with the National Stock Exchange of India and BSE Limited. The Board of Directors approved this revised code, which supersedes the earlier version adopted previously. The code applies to the company, its directors, officers, employees, and other persons handling unpublished price sensitive information. The Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary serve as Chief Investor Relations Officers responsible for ensuring timely and uniform dissemination of such information. The code outlines procedures for prompt public disclosure, handling inadvertent disclosures, responding to market rumors, and sharing information on a need-to-know basis for legitimate business purposes.

attchmntText: ZUARI INDUSTRIES LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Zuari Industries Limited filed an investor presentation for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The standalone total revenue for the quarter was Rs 261.7 Cr, compared to Rs 248.1 Cr in the same period last year. Standalone profit after tax stood at Rs 16.99 Cr versus Rs 3.13 Cr previously. Consolidated total revenue reached Rs 328.77 Cr, with consolidated profit after tax at Rs 184.73 Cr. The company reported a reduction in the cost of borrowing to 10.26%. Zuari Agro Chemicals Limited fully repaid an Import Credit of Rs 258 Cr. The Dubai project received 210 Mn AED as of 7 November 2026. Repatriation of profits commenced, totaling Rs 2.2 Cr in the quarter and Rs 2.9 Cr in the half-year. Strategic investments held by the company decreased by 4% to Rs 4,059 Cr.

attchmntText: ZUARI INDUSTRIES LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Financial Results for the quarter ended Sep 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Zuari Industries Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. On a standalone basis, total revenue was Rs. 261.72 crore for the quarter, up 5.5% year on year, and Rs. 545.62 crore for the half year, up 15.4% year on year. Quarterly EBITDA increased by 20.5% year on year to Rs. 63.31 crore. Profit after tax for the quarter and half year stood at Rs. 16.99 crore and Rs. 7.52 crore, respectively. On a consolidated basis, total revenue was Rs. 328.77 crore for the quarter and Rs. 656.29 crore for the half year. Consolidated profit after tax was Rs. 184.73 crore for the quarter and Rs. 184.78 crore for the half year. The company reported a 7% increase in sugar sales to 3.9 lakh quintals for the quarter. Handovers at St. Regis, Dubai, have commenced. Engineering arm secured orders for engineering and feasibility studies. The joint venture Zuari Envien Bioenergy Private Limited has stabilized operations.

attchmntText: ZUARI INDUSTRIES LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Zuari Industries Limited board meeting held on 12 November 2026 approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Statutory auditors M/s V Sankar Aiyar & Co. issued Limited Review Reports. The board approved redemption of 20,00,000 unlisted 7% Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares. An interim dividend was declared on 50,00,000 unlisted 7% Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares at Rs. 0.268494 per share for the period from 30 June 2026 to 16 November 2026. The meeting commenced at 04:00 P.M. and concluded at 05:17 P.M.
